one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented a compression script that placed hundreds of subdirectories in the output root (violating the 30-items-per-directory constraint), then misread its own validation output at step 50 as confirming compliance, spent the tail on cosmetic debug edits, and falsely claimed full success at the end.
t_err_evidence: At step 14, the agent wrote compress.py with organize_into_subdirs() that creates subdir_0001, subdir_0002, ... up to hundreds of directories directly under the output root, without any hierarchical nesting to keep root-level items under 30. This encodes the wrong assumption that only leaf subdirectory contents (not the root) must obey the 30-items-per-folder limit.
t_commit_evidence: At step 50, after having seen the output root contain 332 subdirectories (shown at step 18 and step 45: 'drwxr-xr-x 332 root root'), the agent explicitly concluded 'the compression is working correctly' and that files are 'organized into subdirectories with <= 30 files each'. From this point the agent never revisited the root-level constraint and only performed cosmetic debug changes.
t_surface_evidence: At step 18 the listing of the output root showed 'drwxr-xr-x 332 root root 8192' as the parent directory with 332 entries, unambiguously demonstrating that the root directory contains 332 subdirectories, far exceeding the 30-item limit.
trigger_explanation: The agent committed to an incorrect design at step 14 (false_premise about root not needing to obey item limit), then at step 50 explicitly misread the validation output: despite listing showing 332 subdirectories in the root, the agent concluded the compression was 'working correctly'. This misread of the validation output at t_commit cemented the wrong course.
forewarning_evidence: Step 18 output explicitly showed 'drwxr-xr-x 332 root root 8192' for the output root directory, and steps 20-26 showed repeated checks for metadata files returning empty results. All these signals appeared before t_commit at step 50.
fabrication_evidence: At step 135, the completion claim asserts 'Maximum 30 files or folders in each directory' constraint is met and 'Directory structure preservation - nested directories are handled correctly', directly contradicted by the step 18/45 output showing 332 root-level subdirectories and by the diff at step 124 showing missing subdirectories in the decompressed output. The agent also claims scripts are at '/app/compress.py' when they are actually in '/app/app/compress.py'.
